ios.desc:
A daily history puzzle. You get a card and a timeline — slot it in the right place, keep going, miss three times and it's over. Sounds easy? It isn't. The years get closer with every card you place.

Built around a Wordle-style daily challenge: one shared puzzle a day, build a streak, share your grid (no spoilers).

· 20+ DECKS: from World History and War & Conflict to Chart Toppers, Disney & Pixar, Blockbuster Cinema, Hip-Hop Chronicles, and more                                                                      · · · DAILY PUZZLE: a fresh challenge every day, with streaks to build and beat
· THREE LIVES: climbing difficulty, no second chances, no pay-to-win                                                                                                                                       
· PERFECT RUNS: earn two stars on every deck and unlock the lore                                                                                                                                           
· LEARN SOMETHING: every card comes with a surprising fact you'll actually remember                                                                                                                        
· DESIGNED FOR ONE HAND: quick rounds, beautiful dark interface, no clutter

Whether you grew up arguing about which came first - Pulp Fiction or The Lion King - or you just like proving how much trivia you've absorbed by accident, Deckades is built for you.                                                                                                                          

· Game Center leaderboards & achievements
· Daily reminders so you never break your streak

quotes.text:
Deckades is a daily timeline trivia game. It shows you a film, song, invention, historical event, etc. and you slot it on a growing timeline by the year it was released/happened. It gets harder with every card as the timeline gets crowded and you only get 3 lives to place all 10 cards. The daily puzzle is the same for everyone, with a share grid at the end so you can compare.

Built solo over the last 3 weeks, with heavy use of Claude Code. The hardest part was getting the card data right without hallucinations, there are currently 2000+ cards. Also, getting it approved on the app store.

The link above takes you to the website with a playable version of the daily. There's also a native iOS app with ~50 themed decks (Disney & Pixar, Hip-Hop Chronicles, Blockbuster Cinema, World History, etc.): https://apps.apple.com/app/id6763564547?pt=deckades&ct=hn-show-launch

Happy to answer any questions.
